cards.gloss_en: a thick rope or chain holding a ship's anchor
cards.ex_en: The ship's cable held it fast to the dock.
cards.ex_cn: 船的锚缆把它牢牢系在码头。

cards.gloss_en: easily and without difficulty
cards.ex_en: She readily agreed to help us.
cards.ex_cn: 她欣然同意帮我们。

cards.gloss_en: a place where people settle to live; a colony
cards.ex_en: They built a small settlement by the river.
cards.ex_cn: 他们在河边建了个小定居点。

cards.gloss_en: british money measured in pounds
cards.ex_en: The book cost ten pounds sterling.
cards.ex_cn: 这本书花了十英镑。

cards.gloss_en: things or parts made of iron
cards.ex_en: The old gate was made of fine ironwork.
cards.ex_cn: 那扇旧门由精致铁艺制成。

cards.gloss_en: a person who manages another's property or affairs
cards.ex_en: The steward looked after the whole house.
cards.ex_cn: 管家照看整座房子。

cards.gloss_en: long journeys made by sea
cards.ex_en: He made many long voyages by sea.
cards.ex_cn: 他多次远洋航行。

cards.gloss_en: large farms growing crops like sugar or cotton
cards.ex_en: They grew sugar on large plantations.
cards.ex_cn: 他们在大种植园里种甘蔗。

cards.gloss_en: to deal with or get rid of something
cards.ex_en: Please dispose of the old boxes.
cards.ex_cn: 请把旧箱子处理掉。

cards.gloss_en: in a way that cannot be avoided
cards.ex_en: Winter inevitably comes after autumn.
cards.ex_cn: 冬天必然在秋天之后到来。

cards.gloss_en: to turn something over; to capsize
cards.ex_en: A big wave overset the little boat.
cards.ex_cn: 一个大浪掀翻了小船。

cards.gloss_en: long flat pieces of sawn wood
cards.ex_en: He nailed the planks together to make a floor.
cards.ex_cn: 他把木板钉在一起做地板。

cards.gloss_en: a sweet strengthening drink or liquor
cards.ex_en: She drank a glass of fruit cordial.
cards.ex_cn: 她喝了一杯果味甜饮。

cards.gloss_en: packed or put away neatly
cards.ex_en: He stowed the bags under the seat.
cards.ex_cn: 他把包塞到座位下面。

cards.gloss_en: a hanging bed of cloth or netting
cards.ex_en: He slept in a hammock between two trees.
cards.ex_cn: 他睡在两棵树间的吊床上。

cards.gloss_en: a period of time between two events
cards.ex_en: There was a short interval between the two songs.
cards.ex_cn: 两首歌之间有段短暂间隔。

cards.gloss_en: to tell apart; to see a difference
cards.ex_en: Can you distinguish red from green?
cards.ex_cn: 你能分辨红色和绿色吗?

cards.gloss_en: goods or articles of a certain kind
cards.ex_en: The shop sold pots and other ware.
cards.ex_cn: 那家店卖锅具和别的器皿。

cards.gloss_en: a wooden barrel for holding liquids
cards.ex_en: The wine was kept in a wooden cask.
cards.ex_cn: 酒装在木桶里。

cards.gloss_en: spread out in a scattered, untidy way
cards.ex_en: A few straggling plants grew by the wall.
cards.ex_cn: 墙边长着几株散乱的植物。

cards.gloss_en: a firm decision or determination
cards.ex_en: Nothing could shake her firm resolve.
cards.ex_cn: 什么都动摇不了她坚定的决心。

cards.gloss_en: to crush or sharpen by rubbing
cards.ex_en: They grind wheat into flour.
cards.ex_cn: 他们把麦子磨成面粉。

cards.gloss_en: a fever with fits of cold and heat
cards.ex_en: The traveller shook with a bad ague.
cards.ex_cn: 那旅人因疟疾直发抖。

cards.gloss_en: the act of keeping safe or alive
cards.ex_en: The old town is in good preservation.
cards.ex_cn: 那座古城保存良好。

cards.gloss_cn: 占上风、盛行;(prevail upon)对…起作用、萦绕心头
cards.gloss_en: won out; (prevail upon) to work upon or persuade
cards.ex_en: In the end, good sense prevailed.
cards.ex_cn: 最终理智占了上风。

cards.gloss_en: small green sour citrus fruits
cards.ex_en: She squeezed two limes into the water.
cards.ex_cn: 她把两个青柠挤进水里。

cards.gloss_en: a large branch of a tree
cards.ex_en: A bird sat on the high bough.
cards.ex_cn: 一只鸟停在高高的树枝上。

cards.gloss_en: the act of living somewhere; a home
cards.ex_en: They took up residence in a new house.
cards.ex_cn: 他们搬进新居住了下来。

cards.gloss_en: the flowing back of the tide
cards.ex_en: We walked on the sand at the ebb.
cards.ex_cn: 退潮时我们在沙滩上散步。

cards.gloss_en: in the same way; also
cards.ex_en: He worked hard, and she did likewise.
cards.ex_cn: 他努力工作,她也一样。

cards.gloss_en: cruel and without human feeling
cards.ex_en: The prisoners suffered inhuman treatment.
cards.ex_cn: 囚犯遭受了非人的对待。

cards.gloss_en: schemes or plans; also cleverly made devices
cards.ex_en: He built clever contrivances to catch fish.
cards.ex_cn: 他造了些巧妙的装置来捕鱼。

cards.gloss_en: to do something wrong or illegal
cards.ex_en: He would never commit a crime.
cards.ex_cn: 他绝不会犯罪。

cards.gloss_en: held the arms tightly so one cannot move
cards.ex_en: The guards pinioned the thief's arms.
cards.ex_cn: 卫兵缚住了小偷的双臂。

cards.gloss_en: people held captive to force others to act
cards.ex_en: The robbers held two hostages.
cards.ex_cn: 劫匪扣了两名人质。

cards.gloss_en: wandering; moving about without a fixed aim
cards.ex_en: His rambling story had no clear point.
cards.ex_cn: 他散漫的故事没个重点。

cards.gloss_en: reasoned earnestly to dissuade someone
cards.ex_en: His father expostulated with him about the plan.
cards.ex_cn: 父亲就那个计划规劝他。

cards.gloss_en: a worker skilled with tools or machines
cards.ex_en: The mechanic fixed our car quickly.
cards.ex_cn: 技工很快修好了我们的车。

suspect.ctx: It would take up a larger volume than this whole work is intended to be to set down all the contrivances I hatched, or rather brooded upon,
suspect.issue: 书中 contrivances I hatched/brooded upon 指心中反复盘算的"计谋、方案、办法"(为对付食人者),是抽象谋划,非实体"装置/发明物";现释义只取实物义,回读"我孵化/苦思的巧妙装置"不通
suspect.suggest: 增补抽象义"计谋、盘算、想出的办法"(scheme/plan),实物义作为次义

suspect.ctx: this prevailed very often upon my thoughts; but, however, the words made a great impression
suspect.issue: 此处为 prevail upon 结构,意为"强烈作用于、缠住/萦绕(思想)";现释义"盛行/占上风"套进"盛行于我的思想"读来别扭,漏了 prevail upon 的作用义
suspect.suggest: 增补"(prevail upon)对…起强烈作用、萦绕心头、缠住"义
